status: sensitivity analysis (CONVENTION3 §5, E4 extras: GENIE3 / GRNBoost2, direction test); no pass/fail
spec:
E4b shared definitions: regulator / target sets, direction-test pairs, cell tiers.

Specification (fixed before any GRN result was seen):
  contexts      lung, lung_external, kidney_B, immune, kidney_A
  regulators R  = TFs appearing in cache/<ctx>/h3_pairs.npz  U  Lambert TFs in V (input features)
  targets T     = every gene appearing as a target in h3_pairs (positives and candidate non-edges)
                  U the endpoints of the direction-test pairs (needed so that importance(j -> i) exists;
                  these extra targets are used ONLY by the direction test)
  tiers         T1 = cache/<ctx>/expr_extraction.npy (the exact extraction cells), seeds 0..4
                T2 = cache/<ctx>/expr.npy (3,000 cells), seeds 0..1
  GENIE3        ExtraTreesRegressor(n_estimators=300, max_features='sqrt', random_state=seed)
  GRNBoost2     GradientBoostingRegressor(learning_rate=0.01, n_estimators=1000, max_depth=3, subsample=0.9,
                max_features=0.1, n_iter_no_change=25, validation_fraction=0.1, random_state=seed)
  importance    feature_importances_ normalised to sum 1 per target; a regulator is never its own feature
                (self column = 0, never scored because no h3 pair has TF == target)
  pair score    importance(TF -> target); importances that are exactly 0 stay 0 (ties -> mid-rank)
  headline      per (method, tier): seed-ensemble score = mean of the per-seed normalised importances;
                per-seed AUROCs reported with mean and SD (run-to-run variability)
  direction     TRRUST i->j with i, j in R, (j, i) in no regulatory set (TRRUST U DoRothEA any level, both
                files = cache any_regulatory.npy); compare importance(i->j) with importance(j->i)
compute_plan_resume: Resumed twice (session cut-off; machine reboot at ~22:47). A temporary plan to drop kidney_B T2 (load average ~470) was cancelled at 19:18 when load fell; T2 seed 0 then finished for lung, lung_external and kidney_B, and the optional T2 seed 1 jobs (queues E and F, the latter restarted from batch checkpoints after the reboot) restored the full design. grn_runs.csv lists every (context, tier, method, seed) fit and whether it is complete; every completed fit is used.
convention3_errata_item3: Not applicable: E4b reports no vertex-subsampling interval. All edge-level intervals are the two-way (TF x target) pigeonhole cluster bootstrap of CONVENTION3 §6; the direction-test intervals are exact Clopper-Pearson and a source-regulator cluster bootstrap.
esm2_note: No ESM2 embedding is used in E4b.
symmetric_scorers_note: Signed cosine and |co-expression| are symmetric (score(i,j) = score(j,i)); in the direction test every pair is tied for them by construction (n_untied = 0), so they cannot carry direction.
compute_plan_original: Initial plan: T1 5 seeds (0-4) in every context; T2 2 seeds (0,1) in immune and kidney_A and 1 seed (0) in lung, lung_external, kidney_B (fallback pre-authorised by the task when T2 x 2 seeds x 5 contexts exceeds ~8 h; measured: lung T2 = 35 min GENIE3 + 102 min GRNBoost2 per seed on an uncontended estimate, ~3x slower under the machine's actual load). Seed 1 for the three large contexts was added later as optional work.

bootstrap.type: two-way TF x target pigeonhole (stats3.StratifiedPairs.bootstrap); TF-only as check
bootstrap.paired: identical weight draws for every score within a context

direction_test_inference: exact two-sided binomial sign test on untied pairs, Clopper-Pearson 95% CI, plus a source-regulator cluster bootstrap (B = 2,000); exact test, no permutation floor
